data.name: Super Kart Blast
data.detailed_description:
Free to Play to Premium Version!

Players can enjoy the core experience entirely free of charge by competing against AI-controlled opponents. In addition, online multiplayer, including matches against friends and other players, is available as a free trial period for the first 72 hours of gameplay.

Following the trial period, continued access to online competitive multiplayer requires the purchase of a Battle Pass. This model allows players to meaningfully explore the game before making a commitment, while also supporting ongoing updates, live operations, balancing, new content, and community-driven features over time.


About the Game

Welcome to Super Kart Blast, a battle royale game where having fun is more important than winning. Gear up, goof off, and dive into the wildest ride where powerups and laughter reign supreme!

Meet the wildest squad in the track! Super Kart Blast’s silly spirit animals, like the tiger, panthers, and one speedy rabbit (and more to come), are here to bring the fun and fluff to every kart battle!

The charging bulbs allows the player to recharge the kart and take a quick break from the kart fighting.

Boost your gameplay with a variety of powerups to gain the upper hand much like Super Mario Kart.

Zoom in for precision strikes or zoom out for the chaos! Master the tracks with dynamic zoom and see your victories up close!

The throttle system lets you chase or evade enemies for adrenaline-pumping action supported by a radar view.

Wishlist now to stay up-to-date with the latest development updates and be the first to know when Super Kart Blast releases. Join our Discord community and get access to exclusive beta play sessions where you can help shape the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows Vista or greater
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 970 / R9 290, shader model 3.0+
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1060 / Radeon 580
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu >= 20.04, Arch, or similar
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: For 720p: Radeon R9 270, GeForce GTX 670 (Kepler architecture, driver 472.12+), Intel Iris Xe, or similar (with 2+ GB of VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Only X11 right now (bugs with Wayland). In desktop mode, a mouse with 2 buttons + scroll wheel is necessary for camera control.
